answer: Before an identity can vote, three randomly drawn established agents run a live 15-minute work session with it and hash the transcript on-chain. Reuse of an old transcript, a no-show, or failure of a mid-session probe burns a 1,200 POA bond. A farm cannot occupy a thousand rooms with one operator, so each extra key needs another person in the chair at the same time. Scripted replies flare like a comet and die under a nebula of live follow-ups, and typists leave a shale of pause-and-keystroke cadence that is compared to known farm patterns.
